battle:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high fidelity desktop card game UI screen, landscape 16:10, a single full-screen interface, straight-on flat view, no device frame, no surrounding presentation board.
Project: 时之勇者 / CHRONO REQUIEM. Medieval sword-and-magic card game about moving future actions on a timeline, clashes, parries and resonance, climbing a seven-floor clock tower.
Art direction: FATE TAPESTRY / 命运织锦. The entire interface is one meticulously woven medieval narrative tapestry. Flat heraldic illustration, elongated angular human silhouettes, profile faces, bold cloaks, stylized animals, tiny botanical millefleur motifs in quiet areas, embroidered running-stitch edges, woven geometry and intentional fabric joins. Heroic, strange, tactile, refined, slightly austere. Modern clear readable information hierarchy integrated into an authentic tapestry visual language.
Palette: warm natural flax #E8D9B9, dark ink-indigo #202D3A, madder red #923F35, muted ochre-gold #B28A45, moss green #69745C. Matte yarn with very subtle fiber texture, crisp silhouette edges. Gold means muted golden thread. Broad flat fields, bold shapes, spacious layout, restrained geometric stitched borders. Keep texture very quiet under text.
Consistent identity: faceless or simplified-profile knight in ivory armor and a madder-red surcoat, shield with an eight-point woven knot; assassin in moss-green hood and narrow cloak; mage in indigo robe bearing an ochre star and staff. Enemies are stylized heraldic beasts, never realistic portraits.
Typography: large elegant confident Chinese Song-style serif titles, neat fully legible Chinese body type, small widely spaced Roman serif Latin. Exact Chinese text specified below must be clean and correct; do not invent unreadable filler text.
Avoid: anime, photorealism, 3D render, glossy gems, blue neon glow, polished gold metal filigree, generic mobile fantasy UI, modern dashboard panels, rounded app cards, leather or parchment scrapbook, literal photographed hanging wall object, overhead table shot, perspective distortion, excessive stitches behind numbers, fake illegible paragraphs. This must feel like a cohesive usable videogame UI, not a poster.

SCREEN: main BATTLE interface.
Composition: top narrow flax masthead about 8% height; an illustrated arena frieze about 27% height; the tactical timeline about 30% height; hand cards and controls about 31% height; a slim battle log footer.
Masthead: woven knot emblem at left, title "时之勇者", small "CHRONO REQUIEM"; at right "第 1 层" and "第 1 回合", small "规则" and "重开".
Arena: two opposing flat woven figures within one continuous indigo-and-flax story scene. Red-cloaked knight at left facing a large grey heraldic wolf at right; narrow plants, tiny stars and a distant thin clock tower embroidered into flat negative space. No enormous VS badge. Under each portrait, slim stitched life ribbons with explicit "勇者 90 / 90" and "灰鬃野狼 40 / 40". Portraits have angular folk-tapestry anatomy, flat color and woven hatching, no anime.
Timeline: title "命运织机" with small "LOOM OF FATE". An actual clear eight-column grid with Roman numerals "I II III IV V VI VII VIII", and three labelled horizontal lanes "敌方", "交锋", "勇者". All columns equal width with thin flax warp threads. Enemy lane uses madder-red stitched attack patches at II "撕咬 6", V "撕咬 6", VIII "撕咬 6". Hero lane uses indigo shield-shaped attack patches at I "击 7", III "击 7", V "击 7". In column V show two additional fine ochre threads converging into a small woven knot to suggest multiple actions aligned at one beat; small center-lane labels "共鸣" and "弹反" should be local tactical markers, never a global combo score. I–III columns have a pale active-window flax tint, IV–VIII quieter. Clear grid and readable empty cells; no chaotic strands.
Bottom: left small woven sand emblem and very large "3", label "时之砂". Center five upright rectangular collectible cards looking like stiff embroidered textile patches, same proportional construction, restrained stitched edges, each 60% flat heraldic illustration and 40% quiet flax text field, each small round sewn cost badge "1". Card names left-to-right "进步", "举盾", "盾击", "迟滞", "战吼". One short readable line each: "攻击提前 1 拍", "获得 8 点护甲", "造成护甲等量伤害", "敌方行动延后 1 拍", "获得 2 层怒气". Motifs respectively a striding boot, a kite shield, a striking shield, a tied thread, a red horn. Right large madder-red cloth-tab primary button "推进时间" with small stitched shuttle icon. Footer small "牌库 10 · 弃牌 0". Keep all five cards fully visible, no overlaps covering text.
Output only the finished single screen.

SCREEN: CLASS SELECTION. A finished single landscape game interface.
Top flax header with knot emblem "时之勇者", small "CHRONO REQUIEM", main page title "选择你的命运".
Main 70% of screen: three tall individually readable banner columns side by side, fabric silhouettes with small bottom fringe. SCREEN: PRE-BATTLE BRIEFING / first floor. Finished single landscape game interface.
Top brand header "时之勇者" and "CHRONO REQUIEM", top-right small "战前情报".
Left 46%: huge magnificent flat heraldic grey wolf in profile with ivory teeth, madder-red small tongue, ornamental curled tail, against an indigo tapestry field. Far right 9%: a narrow vertical tower woven as seven linked geometric battlements, explicit Roman labels I through VII bottom to top, I highlighted in madder-red and gold-thread outline, remaining floors muted.
Bottom right two cloth-tab buttons: secondary "换职业重来" and prominent madder-red "开战" with stitched shuttle emblem. Keep wolf art and practical briefing balanced, all buttons and text comfortably inside screen. Output only this complete screen.

Subtle loose thread at the very bottom joins back into a knot, suggesting a new story may begin. More openness and warm flax than the battle screen; use mastery of spacing and silhouette rather than glow. Output only this complete screen.
battle_final:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET, the tapestry battle UI already generated.
Task: produce the final corrected battle screen. Preserve its complete composition, tactile textile palette, woven knight and heraldic wolf artwork, plant motifs, typography style, overall interface geometry, cloth card visual treatment, masthead and button. Carefully correct game information to the actual existing game, with clear readable Chinese text.
1. Portrait life ribbons must read "勇者 80 / 80" and "灰鬃野狼 70 / 70".
2. Keep eight Roman beat columns and rows 敌方 / 交锋 / 勇者. Correct enemy patches to be present at I, II, IV, V, VII, VIII, all labelled "咬 9"; III and VI enemy cells empty. Hero baseline patches at I, III, V, VII all labelled "击 7", plus a madder-and-gold special hero patch at II labelled "重击 20". Local center-row II preview label "弹反" aligned under enemy 咬9 and above hero 重击20, connected by a small clear crossed-thread knot. Other center cells remain mostly empty. Do not show a misplaced global 共鸣 label. I–III have slightly brighter current-window tint.
3. Replace the five card faces left-to-right with same proportions and illustration style, accurate costs and names:
- "举盾", cost "1", kite shield icon, short copy "本拍敌人每次攻击 −6".
- "盾击", cost "2", striking shield icon, short copy "举盾拍追加攻击 · 4~12".
- "挑衅", cost "1", pulled madder thread or beckoning gauntlet icon, short copy "敌方行动提前 1 拍".
- "铁壁", cost "2", broad tower shield icon, short copy "最重攻击减半 · 怒气 +5".
- "战吼", red rage cost badge "3" with small "怒气" label rather than sand cost, red horn icon, short copy "本回合每次攻击 +4". Show this last card slightly desaturated to express insufficient rage.
4. Keep 时之砂 3 large and clear, add a small clearly subordinate "怒气 0 / 10" status beside hero life information. Footer pile text "牌库 4 · 弃牌 0".
No extra prose, no new systems, no additional labels beyond these and existing general UI. Keep every card and control inside screen. Typography needs to be crisp and cards get quiet low-texture flax description areas. Output one finished full landscape screen, same aspect ratio as reference.
